svg.title: Map symmetry by image and method
svg.desc: Each row is one method, in the order ANNA, UFO, unregularised. Dots are individual seeds and the dark tick is the median. Cat: median ANNA 0.64, UFO 0.59, unregularised 0.36. Butterfly: median ANNA 0.95, UFO 0.95, unregularised 0.84. Skull: median ANNA 0.95, UFO 0.82, unregularised 0.70.
